mods.name: MobPVP
mods.description: MobPVP adds a level system to every mob. Stronger mobs drop better loot and may become minibosses.

releases.notes:
# MobPvP’s BIGGEST update ever 3.2.3 has been RELEASED!
***


Welcome to “A Nuclear Scene,” the largest update since the very first MobPvP release! Packed with a mountain of new features and fixes, MobPvP is now better than ever. After 13 pre-releases, the full version is finally here!

## Added:

### **Creatures:**

* Snot Ball
* Goblin
* Goblin Horse
* Hunter
* The Great Protector (coming soon, boss)

### **Items:**

* Golden Mace
* Iron Mace
* Diamond Mace
* Netherite Mace
* Rye
* Rye Seeds

### **Blocks:**

* Heavy Crusher Head
* Simple Hopper
* Industrial Oven
* Industrial Oven Block
* Rye Crop and its 8 growth stages

### **Sounds:**

* mobpvp:general.open
* mobpvp:goblin.ambient
* mobpvp:goblin.death
* mobpvp:goblin.hurt
* mobpvp:goblin_horse.splash
* mobpvp:machine.run
* mobpvp:walk.copper
* mobpvp:walk.iron
* mobpvp:walk_grass

### **Machines:**

* Crusher Machine
* Industrial Furnace

### **Advancements:**

* Goblin’s Silence

# ****Snot Ball:****

A small but highly functional creature. You can find it wandering around. Feed it 1 slimeball and it becomes your loyal friend. You can ride it, and while mounted you gain these abilities:

* Neither you nor the Snot Ball take fall damage
* You can jump
* Automatically climbs flowing water
* Can crawl
* Can float on water like a boat

However, these abilities only work while riding the Snot Ball. When mounted, your XP bar becomes a jump charge bar. You can charge up to 100 levels the higher the charge, the higher you jump. You can also crawl with W. While crawling, your speed increases slowly like a car, and when you release W you gradually slow down until you stop. To stop quickly, press Left ALT. This almost 1-block-tall creature is tiny but very useful.

# ****Goblin:****

A creature obsessed with gold. You can deceive it easily with a bit of gold. It appears at night like zombies and attacks you. It spawns between level 4 and 10. They are dangerous and irritating. They attack players, iron golems (and variants), and villagers. They can also appear from PvE Summoners.

# ****Goblin Horse:****

Also obsessed with gold. You can trick it with gold as well. Appears at night like zombies, and may spawn with a Goblin riding it. It uses the zombie horse texture and will attack you. It spawns between level 1 and 4. They attack players, iron golems (and variants), and villagers. They can also appear from PvE Summoners.

# ****Hunter:****

A variant of the Pillager. Appears in raids and from PvE Summoners. Similar to a normal Pillager but additionally attacks animals. They spawn between level 1 and 2 and have low health.

# ****The Great Protector (coming soon):****

Does not spawn naturally yet. Cannot be obtained legitimately. A massive boss. Does not have a texture yet.

# Heavy Crusher Head:
To craft it, place an iron block on the ground and right-click with iron. Then break the resulting Industrial Oven block with an axe. Used in Crusher Machine crafting.

# Simple Hopper:
A basic hopper. Slowly drops the items from a chest placed on top.

# Industrial Oven:
To craft it, place an iron block on the ground and right-click with iron. Then right-click the resulting Industrial Oven block with a furnace. Used to build the Industrial Furnace structure.

# Industrial Oven Block:
The foundation of all machines! To craft it, place an iron block on the ground and right-click with iron.

# Maces:
New weapon types have been added. There are 5 variants:

* **Golden Mace:** 50 durability, 1.5 attack damage, 0.5 attack speed. Craft with 1 gold block + 1 copper rod in a crafting table.
* **Iron Mace:** 150 durability, 2.5 attack damage, 0.5 attack speed. Craft in a smithing table using a Golden Mace, iron, and an upgrade template.
* **Copper Mace Reinforced with Iron:** 200 durability, 3.0 attack damage, 1.5 attack speed. Craft in a smithing table using an Iron Mace, iron-reinforced copper, and an upgrade template.
